desc: The Strike Industries Mini King Comp brings the proven performance of the full-size King Comp in a more compact, lighter package. The Mini King Comp retains the full range of features of the King Comp but in a single chamber format. The large single baffle captures the vented gasses, producing a net force forward of the shooter that helps mitigate recoil. The ports work to stabilize the muzzle end for faster follow-up shots while dampening felt recoil on the shooter to maintain a pleasant overall shooting experience. The end of the Mini KING comp features the "crown" of standoff tines that gives the compensator its name.
